Q: Python enum.Flag : best practice for creating "empty" and "full" flags A:

Thank you for this insight! I hadn't realized one could mix enum.auto() and explicitly-set members. The advantage of this approach is that the reprs/strs for the empty/full flags become much more legible. The downside, at least in terms of maintenance, is that WHITE now has to be kept up-to-date when new members are added. But very interestingly, it can be set as ~BLACK!! This has become a very tempting option in my eyes. Another notable point is that these members do not appear in iter(Color), which I find... peculiar... I wonder if that's intended.

Q: java swing jtextfiled unicode sinhala A:

problem was :
Java Swing uses its own text rendering pipeline that lacks proper OpenType shaping support for complex scripts like Sinhala. so ZWJ conjuncts like ශ්‍රී render as broken separate glyphs, Ligatures fail to form, Characters appear in wrong order.
-
i have come up with a solution using HarfBuzz via JNI to correctly shape and render Sinhala text.
-
here is the link to full project source code if anyone needs it :
https://github.com/stark9000/SinhalaEngine/
-
a huge thanks to stack overflow and every one who have tried to help !!

Q: How to deal with GenericAliases with python 3.8 with compability with more recent versions? A:

As commented by @Daniel Fainberg, you can use typing.get_args and typing.get_origin for this:

>>> import typing
>>> typing.get_args(list[int])
(<class 'int'>,)
>>> typing.get_origin(typing.List[int])
<class 'list'>

The former returns a tuple of all the generic type arguments and the latter returns the raw type.

Q: How to install pygame on Mac A:

Python projects should make use of virtual-environments, as isolated environments to keep 3rd party libraries, so you can have projects that use diverging library versions in the same computer - there are various ways of creating and maintaining those, including explicitly selecting that inside vscode.

(I find it much easier to do so using the terminal, using tools like either Pyenv, or Python's built-in python -m venv or Astral UV) -

In either case, you have to setup a venv with a proper Python version (the Python that ships with MacOS, if there is one, is usually outdated - Homebrew brings an up-to-date version)

Anf finally, once you find your way around virtualenvs, and how do activate then, or assign a virtualenv to a project inside VSCode, you have two options of Pygame to install: the original Pygame, which due to slow response in implementing some features and a bit more contributor divergence were forked - so there is also "pygame-ce" - the last one is possibly better maintained, and is a drop-in replacement.

Q: Missing Scopes Required when calling Microsoft Graph from ASP .Net Core Web Api A:

Try changing the user consent settings

  • Go to Azure Active Directory and then Enterprise applications from their consent and permissions now select User Consent settings
  • Under User consent for applications choose the consent settings you want to provide to user
